title: CryptoCompare
description: Integration with CryptoCompare API providing cryptocurrency market data, price information, and crypto news with rate limiting capabilities

cryptocompare_fetch_news.title: Fetch News
cryptocompare_fetch_news.description:
This tool fetches the latest cryptocurrency news articles for a specific token.
You can optionally specify a timestamp to get historical news, otherwise it uses the current time.
Returns articles in English with details like title, body, source, and publish time.

cryptocompare_fetch_price.title: Fetch Price
cryptocompare_fetch_price.description: Provides real-time cryptocurrency pricing with multi-exchange aggregation and historical comparisons

cryptocompare_fetch_trading_signals.title: Fetch Trading Signals
cryptocompare_fetch_trading_signals.description: Generates technical analysis signals using indicators like RSI, MACD, and Bollinger Bands

cryptocompare_fetch_top_market_cap.title: Fetch Top Market Cap
cryptocompare_fetch_top_market_cap.description: Tracks top cryptocurrencies by market capitalization with sector breakdowns

cryptocompare_fetch_top_exchanges.title: Fetch Top Exchanges
cryptocompare_fetch_top_exchanges.description: Ranks cryptocurrency exchanges by liquidity and trading volume with market pair analysis

cryptocompare_fetch_top_volume.title: Fetch Top Volume
cryptocompare_fetch_top_volume.description: Analyzes 24h trading volume trends across exchanges and currency pairs
